components.name: Top navigation
components.description: Top navigation — the bar at the top of a mobile/tablet screen: leading Back/Close, centred title (or large title, or search), up to two trailing actions. Background=Transparent sits over photos (buttons on fill/on-media). Pair with Status bar above. Web uses Header · Web (6.2).

6.6 Top navigation
The bar at the top of a mobile or tablet screen — Menu/Back/Close, title, up to two actions and an optional avatar. 48 variants · Type × Leading × Background × Direction.
Overview
Every pushed screen has one. Pair it with the Status bar above (10.2). On web the same role is played by Header · Web (6.2).
